The remaining items are: an oak dining table, a sewing cabinet, twelve boxes of books, and four framed paintings. Our usual practice is to go around the group so everyone can raise any practical or personal considerations before I finalize the plan. So let's start — does anyone have thoughts on any of these items, whether you'd like to keep something yourself or know an organization that could use it?
